reviews.text:
We first found Wicker Park Veterinary Clinic about 12 years ago, shortly after moving to Chicago, when our two dogs simply needed their regular check-ups. At the time, we lived only a couple of blocks away. Since then, we’ve moved farther north, but Wicker Park Vet has remained our veterinary practice for routine care, annual check-ups, and those occasional times when one of our dogs needs to be seen quickly.

Over the years, we sadly said goodbye to both of the dogs who first brought us to WPV, and the care and compassion we received during those difficult times meant a great deal to us. We have since welcomed new dogs into our family, and they have taken to Wicker Park Vet just as happily.

The entire staff has always been friendly, responsive, and helpful, and they have accommodated us more than once when we needed a quick appointment. Dr. Mowry remains a particular favorite of ours. She is patient, kind, thoughtful, and always takes the time to make both us and our dogs comfortable. Most importantly, our dogs genuinely seem to love her.

12 years, several dogs, and a move across the city later, we still choose Wicker Park Vet. That probably says more than anything else. We highly recommend Dr. Mowry and the entire team.
Great experience today with my dog Stark. Dr Ziomek and the vet tech were so nice to my dog and handled everything with so much care

I had Dr. Milkowski and her team check out my cat and she was great at explaining all my options and answering any questions when it came to my concerns. Yes you have to put down around $80 deposit but if you show up on time then it just gets put towards your bill. Overall this clinic is a good choice that doesn’t price gouge.

By far the best vet in Chicago. We have been taking our dog here since she was a puppy, Dr. Mowry is one of the kindest Vets, and all of the vet techs are as well. Everyone is patient, friendly, and they really assure you your pet is in the best hands. One of the best things I found about them is their responsiveness, we could get our dog seen same day almost any time during business hours and they don’t charge outrageous fees like you would see at an emergency vet. We are moving out of the city and going to miss them terribly, so if you’re in Chicago I would highly recommend!

Apologies to the Dr’s and Techs this review likely doesn’t do justice to. After reading other reviews it sounds like this may be a staffing issue but FWIW a warning to potential clients on level of care by staff.

I attempted to bring my dog here because it was close in proximity after he was attacked by a  larger dog in Wicker Park. I was visibly in tears, my dog in complete shock, bleeding from his puncture wounds at the neck. As I go to enter I was greeted by a woman who I rapidly explain the situation to but she stops me to say they were closed and there are no vets on site. Understandable — I know I need to pivot somewhere else.

I ask for a rec to anywhere else I can take him to which she mentioned a place in south loop and quickly locked the door.

Maybe it’s just me but if I were an employee at a vet clinic I would have at the very least offered to wait with the patient and owner in distress while they get their ride?

The brief encounter left such a distaste due to the lack of concern by professionals who should exercise the most and I will not recommend anyone leave their pet in the care of people who don’t show basic empathy.

I ended up taking my dog to Partners Animal Hospital in West Loop (arriving just minutes before close) and was met with soooo much care and compassion. Everyone there was so calm in my chaos, springing into action. I will continue to take my dog there and recommend them anytime I have the chance!
We could not be happier with Wicker Park Vet for our cat and dog. The care is great, we love the doctor and find the prices to be fair.

I cannot recommend this veterinary practice enough. Dr. Mowry cared for my dog Lily from 2013 until her recent passing, and I am forever grateful for the trust, compassion, and dedication she showed us every single visit.
She is not only an exceptional veterinarian, but a genuinely kind and caring human being and someone I trusted completely, even when it came to making the hardest final decision.
I am not alone in feeling this way about both Dr. Mowry and Wicker park vet. Friends of mine have also brought their dogs to Dr. Mowry and have experienced that same exceptional level of care and compassion.
The entire staff deserves recognition as well. Every single person treated both Lily and me with such love and warmth. When we lost Lily, they sent the kindest sympathy card that meant so much to me. It showed just how much they truly care about the animals and families they serve.
Thank you, Dr. Mowry and the entire team, for giving Lily such a beautiful life of care!

We had such a wonderful experience at Wicker Park Veterinary Clinic! Dr. Mullin and Myra took incredible care of our dog and truly went above and beyond. Dr. Mullin listened carefully to all of my concerns and took the time to explain everything, helping us feel confident in the plan moving forward.

What really stood out was how kind and gentle everyone was. Our dog was actually happy to be there, which says so much! It’s clear that they genuinely care about the animals they treat and the families who love them.

We are so grateful for their compassion, professionalism, and dedication. Thank you for taking such amazing care of our pup! 🐾

I have been going to this vet for over 5 years and love it so much. The front desk is always so kind and accommodating. The doctors are brilliant, honest and present. I will continue to be a very happy client.
Wonderful experience they did everything they could to make my pup feel comfortable during his exam and the vet gave great non-partial advice. I love the fact it's still locally owned as well.
We’ve been bringing our dog and cat here for years. Everyone we’ve met with has been great and we’re so thankful to have a trusted opinion looking after our pets. Thank you!

This place is so great. I love that we get the same vet most of the time - Dr. Singleton is smart, a great listener, and patient/owner centered. When we've had one of her partners cover they have been excellent as well. Staff are all helpful and kind.
Was recommended this place by a friend and haven't looked back. WPV staff and doctors genuinely care about my cats and make it easy and as hassle-free to get what I need, including their knowledge.

I’ve been going here for a few years. I’d say front desk staff is professional and high performing, friendly 80-90% of the time, the vet techs are really good, it’s a newly renovated clinic, and the overall care is good, though one must endure the high end of high city prices for vet care here. I had trouble connecting with the veterinarians themselves however, initially just due to some turnover early on/ getting switched around that eventually stabilized. However, I had most difficulty appreciating Dr. Santiago’s bedside manner and ability to provide empathy or practical help to me as I navigated what felt to me like really challenging and overwhelming health issues with my senior cats. I would recommend Wicker Park Vet Clinic to others, but given the trajectory of care I happen to have received, I’ve decided to look elsewhere for care.
Lucy has a cough how do you get weather today

New waiting room is awesome! There were dividers to keep nervous pets separate from other animals. Dr Santiago is kind and knowledgeable. I've taken my baby daughter (cat) there twice now for checkups and they were fast and caring. They never fat shamed my cat and gave the the info to get her down 2lbs and also help her gingivitis. Reasonably priced. About 400 for multiple vaccines (including the 3 year rabies shot), blood work, and urinalysis.

We have been going to Wicker Park Vet for two years.  While it took a bit to get in as a new patient, it was worth the wait!  The staff is always so responsive and friendly, which I really appreciate and speaks volume of how wonderful this place is.  Dr. Singleton is also so attentive and really listens to all your concerns.  Highly recommend!

I am so grateful for the care my rescue dog receives here! Maggie is dog reactive, and they got her in and out no issues even before the construction, and now it’s even easier. Maggie doesn’t always get a lot of love (she’s a pittie, ugh) - but she has many fans here. Sabrina goes out of her way to say hi every time we are in and it makes my day. Doing things like vet appointments can be really stressful with her, and Wicker Park Vet meets me, and sweet Maggie, where she is at. (Despite the fact she looks suspicious here!)

Mostly good experiences here. However one time they charged me for a cone that I didn't want and made me wait in a room for 20 minutes until they brought me the thing I didn't want. It never occured to them to ask if i wanted it or if I wanted to wait an absurd amount if time for the stupid cone.

We've been going to this clinic for over a year now, since our pup was just a few weeks old. Every time we go there, I'm blown away by the great care our dog receives. The staff is helpful and kind, and the docs are very competent. You can immediately see that everyone absolutely loves dogs. We always feel that our concerns are heard and taken seriously. Getting our girl spayed was worrying us sick, but Dr. Milkowski and the team did a wonderful job, everything went very well, and the recovery was smooth. We couldn't be happier. Highly recommended!
They should tell you when you book an appointment the 15 min policy of getting to your appointment, I was 2 min late……
My dogs love it here! Every time we walk by, they want to come inside. Everyone is super nice and professional and so very kind.

We've been taking our cats here for years & they've always done a great job.  Took one of our cats in today for an ear infection & they were very helpful & answered every question I had.  Highly recommended

Could not recommend. They did a fine job with our cats tooth extraction but bedside manner/follow up on surgery and communication before and after the surgery were all severely lacking. Spent thousands of dollars and just left not feeling too good about the overall experience.
Wicker Park Vet is wonderful. Have been taking our dog here for years. They are flexible, very caring for our boi and reasonable priced. Would absolutely recommend!
I’ve been coming to Wicker Park Veterinary Clinic for years, and I’ve always been very happy with their staff, their vets, and the services they provide.  Very highly recommended!!

If you visit these facilities with a cat DO. NOT. VISIT. DR. MAKOWSKI. Wicker Park Vet was a great vet when my cat and I were visiting Dr Darcy. The clinic does not prioritize cats, and may be a great place as a dog parent, but as a cat parent they will prescribe you the same wipes every time, and kick you out the door spending $100+. I went as a regular patient, had been visiting for 5 years, my cat was having issues with her anal glands. They proceeded to take her to the back, and come back dramatically, almost making me feel responsible, that my cat had bitten the vet. I would think when sticking a foreign object up an animals nether regions, you would set up some kind of restraints for them, but apparently it was my fault.

My cat would have to be drugged, per my expense, if she was to return. We had never had any issues with any vet, (she is adopted and has visited Animal Cruelty Society) any babysitter, or any visitor. I was treated like my cat was violent when it was neglected proper care. After being condescendingly explained what anal glands are, they sent me home saying there is no problem and sold me a fecal test. I dropped off the test and heard no response of any kind. (after being a patient of 5+ years) they like to say they have the wrong email for me but i receive all of their other emails. They said they "forgot to attach the medical results" when i called, when I received no email period, while receiving marketing emails inbetween.

She is now experiencing extreme issues to her anal area, after being told nothing was wrong and that she was a violent cat that needed to be drugged if she was to enter the facility again.

I have been bringing my dogs here for four years and have always had excellent experiences. Today we laid my dog Jake to rest and it was a very smooth experience. From scheduling, to Dr. Darcy’s kindness to the assistants who gave him French fries from their own lunch. It’s good to know he was taken care of in death as well as he was in life at this clinic.
Veterinarian staff are wonderful. Prices are a little high… more expensive than our vet in NYC! The facility is clean and well maintained
Our kitty just turned 21 thanks to Dr Cohen and the amazing staff.
Hands down one of the best vets in Chicago! All four of my pets have been going there for the past few years ever since we moved to Chicago. Fair pricing and friendly staff!
